name: grill-to-spec
description: Codex plugin for grilling requirements, generating PRD.json, rendering Spec Kit-compatible specs, evaluating output quality, and archiving a planning handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Turn grilled context into PRD.json, task artifacts, specs, evals, and a local Spec Kit planning handoff.
interface.longDescription: Runs a phase-gated Codex planning workflow: grill the user one question at a time, synthesize a machine-actionable PRD.json, decompose the PRD into traceable task artifacts with unchecked tasks, render Spec Kit-compatible markdown, evaluate artifact quality, and save a planning handoff archive with vendored scripts and templates.
defaultPrompt: Create PRD.json, Spec Kit specs, task artifacts, and evals.
Create a planning handoff archive with the eval report.
